name: mask-before-you-ask
description: A private, browser-only checkpoint for masking sensitive details before sharing text.

scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e && npm run deploy:check
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.client.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.e2e.json
